title: feat: fixed score gate, rule cues and own-folder kit tools
headline: The recall gate is fixed at a floor of 14 with two blind scorers and no override, and a lower question counts as worse only when seen twice; the prompt hook puts a rule's own words in front of a session on its topic and cues the closeout after a release; and a session runs its own config folder's kit tools.
alignment: v1.48.0 is build 22 of the v2.0 plan: K198 (with K199, K200 and seen twice), K191, K192, K195, K197, K184, K196, CM6, K193, K182, K171, K206 and R7.2, each reproduced on the released 1.47.0 or proven by a run first.

items.text: The recall gate is fixed: 5 runs a side measured the same day, two blind scorers averaged, a median of at least 14 on wording and behaviour, nothing worse than the release, and no marker that passes a miss.
items.test: tests/kit-recall.test.mjs::recall gate (K198): the floor of 14, two scorers and no worse question or scenario, with no override

items.text: A question or scenario that scores lower than the same-day release is asked again alone, 5 new sessions a side with two new scorers, and counts as worse only when it is lower again.
items.before: One unlucky run made it worse
items.test: tests/gate-seen-twice.test.mjs::a question lower on one look is asked again alone, and is worse only when it is lower twice

items.text: The blind step writes every home, temp and drive path one way, hides a throwaway kit-probes folder but keeps the file named after it, and keeps an answer line that only says "current build".
items.before: Paths told the side; lines lost
items.test: tests/gate-seen-twice.test.mjs::the blind step keeps an answer line that only says current build

items.text: The release arm of a behaviour run gets the skills and roles its install record lists, as the candidate gets its own.
items.test: tests/recall-behave.test.mjs::the release arm (K195) gets its installed kit skills and agents in the probe, as the candidate gets its own

items.text: The prompt hook cues the closeout once when HEAD is the newest release tag, in the rule's own words.
items.test: tests/rule-cues-quiet.test.mjs::the closeout cue fires only when HEAD is the newest release tag

items.text: When a message names a push or PR, a fan-out of reviewers, an idea for later or the review before a PR, the prompt hook puts that rule's own words in front of the session; KIT_RULE_CUES=off turns it off.
items.test: tests/rule-cues-quiet.test.mjs::a rule cue fires on its rule's topic and stays quiet on everyday words that share a word

items.text: Session start names this session's kit tool commands, rules name the tool instead of a fixed home path, skills are filled with the config folder at install, and the launcher holds a tool run from another one.
items.test: tests/kit-home-paths.test.mjs::session start names this session's kit tool commands, in the allow rules' spelling (K206)

items.text: Every tool call starts the guard launcher through kit-start.sh: a 4 second limit, one retry for a slow start or a crash, the cause named, and after three misses the owner is asked to repair.
items.test: tests/guards-outside.test.mjs::the guard start script retries once, names why a start failed, and lets only the launcher answer (R7.2)

items.text: Sweep reviewers are metered in list-price dollars with a ceiling from their own call cap, and a large diff is split into file slices for the diff-reading roles, one reviewer each.
items.test: tests/kit-sweep-budget.test.mjs::a large diff is split into file slices for the diff-reading roles, one reviewer each

items.text: A small PR body is refused when the diff is more than a small change, and the check fails closed when git cannot read the diff.
items.test: tests/kit-hooks.test.mjs::a small PR body is refused when the diff is more than a small change (K184)

items.text: `kit-report.mjs send` keeps nothing when the session runs on another config folder than the project was installed for.
items.test: tests/kit-report.test.mjs::send keeps nothing when the session runs on another Claude folder than the project was installed for (K197)

items.text: Three read-only command shapes the guard held as writes now pass; their write twins stay held.
items.test: tests/guards-hold.test.mjs::three read-only shapes pass, and their write twins stay held (K187, K196)

items.text: The resume packet hashes _State.json, kit status names drift between the state file and its views, and a one-line change to a shipped script or skill counts as fix work.
items.test: tests/resume-packet.test.mjs::the packet hashes _State.json when there is one, and the check names it when it changed (CM6)

items.text: The mutation measure runs the guard proofs on each flip the tests missed, so a proof-only catch counts.
The kit ships Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE files.

verification: Recall, two blind scorers: 14, 14, 14, 14, 13.5 against the released 1.47.0's 12, 12, 12, 13, 13 the same day, control 0; question 2 was lower once and 10 of 10 against 10 of 10 when asked again alone.
Behaviour (suite v2): 13, 14, 14, 14, 14 against the released 1.47.0's 14, 14, 13, 13, 14 the same day, control 5, no scenario worse.
The slice trial (K182): two reviewers on file slices found 40 of 64 planted bugs, one reviewer on the whole change 32 of 64, at 1.7 times the cost (one blind scorer).

decisions.decision: A lower question or scenario is worse only when seen twice
decisions.why: On one look the release scored worse than itself (the owner, 2026-11-21).

decisions.decision: The same-day release is not held against its last recorded score
decisions.why: At a floor of 14 of 14 a low baseline cannot help a candidate pass (the owner, 2026-11-21).

decisions.decision: The guard start limit stays at 4 seconds
decisions.why: The owner picked it; the slowest guard path took under 0.5 s.
New hooks, a new start-up line and a stricter gate reach every project.

upgrading: Run install user, then install project: the settings line now runs /bin/sh and the guard start script, so a home installed before reads as not wired until install user runs. Rule cues can be turned off with KIT_RULE_CUES=off.
limits: The other-folder hold reads a command as written: a folder or script built at run time, a wildcard, Start-Process or a script that spawns node is not read. Rule cues read a message's first 2,000 characters.
